# Input b8-4: the B8.4 synthetic submissions (PROVISIONAL)

- **What:** the fictional submissions of B8.4 (`testdata/b8-4-synthetic-submissions/`, merged in #31, #189 and #190), the planned input of the B8.6 grading-draft item `gd-001`. The set has 33 submissions (B8.4 needs at least 30). Each is graded on the marking table of its B8.2 task.
- **Source:** written for this project by Student 3 (B8.4). Entirely fictional. This set does not copy any submission: it points at the B8.4 set, so the two cannot drift apart.
- **Expected output:** the mentor reference grades of B8.4 (`reference-grades/mentor-01/`, one file per submission). **None exists.** B8.4 has only the author's own grades, labelled as not reference grades. The guide names the mentor (issue #186, B8.4 open item O3); a second mentor on at least 10 submissions is for Release 4 (design Q47). So `gd-001` is pending.
- **In this tree:** B8.4 is merged, so its manifest exists here and the test that reads the path of this input runs. Only the reference grades are missing.
- **Status:** PROVISIONAL.
- **Licence:** Apache-2.0 (decided by the guide, issue #186).
